women-parliament: How women's representation in parliament changed.
Parliamentary seats held by women as a share of the total.
tertiary-enrolment: Gross tertiary enrolment relative to the official age-group population, including students of all ages.
primary-teachers: How pupil-to-teacher ratios changed across countries.
The average number of primary-school pupils per teacher.
private-credit: How private-sector credit changed across economies.
Credit to the private sector as a share of GDP.
electricity-use: How electricity use per person changed.
Electricity consumption per person, measured in megawatt-hours.
undernourishment: The estimated share of people whose habitual food intake provides insufficient dietary energy.
air-pollution: How exposure to fine-particle air pollution changed.
Population-weighted annual PM2.5 exposure, measured in micrograms per cubic metre.
food-output: How food production changed against each country's baseline.
Food production indexed to each country's 2014-2016 average of 100.
science-papers: How scientific publishing changed across countries.
Scientific and technical articles, shown in thousands.
primary-completion: New entrants to the last primary-school grade relative to the relevant-age population.
landline-phones: Fixed telephone subscriptions, shown in millions.
public-consumption: How government consumption changed across economies.
Government final consumption expenditure as a share of GDP.
household-consumption: How household spending per person changed.
Household and nonprofit consumption per person, in thousands of constant 2015 US dollars.
out-of-pocket-health: Where households pay more of the healthcare bill.
Direct household payments as a share of current health expenditure.
tuberculosis: How tuberculosis incidence changed across countries.
Estimated annual new and relapse tuberculosis cases per 100,000 people.
hiv-prevalence: How HIV prevalence changed across countries.
The estimated share of people aged 15-49 living with HIV.
nonperforming-loans: How problem loans changed across banking systems.
Nonperforming loans as a share of total gross loans.

production.broad-beans: dry broad bean and horse bean
